purpose: Detect permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration that may let untrusted origins read responses.
when_to_use: Baseline check on any authorized web application or API (risk 1, passive). Run early; pair findings with manual verification of whether the affected endpoint is credentialed.
detection_approach: Fetch the target and inspect Access-Control-Allow-Origin. A wildcard (*) is reported as suspected. If Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is also true, escalate to confirmed/high — any origin can then read authenticated responses.
